ios.desc:
The smart study planner you have been waiting for. Offers everything you need in a school calendar and college organizer. Well suited for any school, college, and university.

The homework planner offers the following features:

Planner
- Enrollment management with terms and courses
- Add classes with custom class types for your personalized study schedule
- Schedule repetitive and MWF classes
- Skip single classes (attendance tracking) and see an overview for each course in your student agenda
- Delete single classes when they got canceled

Calendar
- Month or week overview of your student calendar
- Shows all activities (Classes, Homework, and Gradings) to have a concise student schedule
- Add extra-curricular events to your study planner

Homework
- Add all your tasks to the homework calendar
- Set priority levels, and reminders
- Create repeating homework
- Filter to show completed ones
- Sort by date, course, or priority to have a clear overview in the homework tracker

Grading
- Add all your assignments with received grades and weights, especially useful when using as a college schedule
- Automatically calculates your course average and shows all gradings on a beautiful chart
- See your GPA/Weighted GPA/Term average in the college planner
- Support for different grade scales (letters, numbers) and ability to customize them for each course
- Set different grading types, and reminders
- Create repeating gradings
- Sort by date or course to have a precise picture in the school organizer
